Vendor / namely hris cost

Namely pricing in 2026

Namely publishes no price: its pricing page is a quote form. The cost is set by the platform, the payroll option (self-service or managed) and the benefits services you take, and your headcount. The vendors in this category that do publish list an HRIS seat at $3 to $29 per employee per month. Get each part of the Namely quote as a separate line, plus implementation and the renewal cap, and set it against the published rates in the ledger.

How the price is built

Ask whether payroll is self-service inside the platform price or a managed service priced as a separate line.

What to get priced in writing

  • The per-employee rate for each module you take, as separate lines
  • Any monthly base or platform fee, stated separately from the per-employee rate
  • Whether any charge is per payroll run rather than per month, and the rate
  • The one-time implementation fee and what it covers
  • The contract term, any seat minimum, and the annual renewal increase cap in writing

For scale, the vendors that do publish an HRIS seat rate list from $3 to $29 per employee per month (every published rate). Enter your Namely quote under “Your quote” in the ledger to set it against them over 3 years.

Does Namely publish its prices?

No. The pricing page is a quote form with no published rate, seat minimum or implementation fee.

How is payroll priced?

Ask Namely whether payroll in your quote is self-service inside the platform price or a managed service priced as a separate line, and get the rate for each.

What should a Namely quote show?

The per-employee platform rate, each add-on as its own line, the payroll option and its price, the implementation fee, the term and the renewal cap.

How does Namely compare with BambooHR or HiBob on cost?

BambooHR publishes Core $10, Pro $17 and Elite $25 per employee per month; HiBob and Namely publish nothing. Compare quotes at your headcount with the modules matched.
